why_null: All four library cases were considered against the motif of this cluster, which is an implementing agency's own running cumulative total standing in for the full national scale of the harm, while two other institutional totals over overlapping windows sit beside it, each resting on a case definition and counting unit no source states, and with no served base or prior-period ledger ever placed under any of them. B-01 (May 2019, moral shock and a count with no ledger behind it) turns on a number that entered circulation without any institution or method behind it and outran every correction; in this cluster each competing total is published by a named body out of a real counting rule that simply goes unstated, so the shape is a definitional gap between three ledgers rather than a number with no origin, and the cluster's disputed step is which rule produced which total, not whether a total was produced at all. B-02 (Oct 2020) and B-04 (Jan 2025) are both scope-inflation motifs, a rule narrowed in its own text and widened in the telling, with B-04 the demo set's expected match for the PPN panic; this cluster contains no narrowing instrument whose reach was widened in circulation, and its contested step is arithmetic aggregation rather than the scope of a legal text. B-03 (Aug 2025, moral shock and acceleration) is a shape about the speed at which a single image converts into mobilization within hours; this cluster accumulates announced totals across many months and its unstated step is a jump from a running count to a national measure, which is a reading of scale rather than a compression of time. Shared sector, shared institution class, shared country and shared period would each be surface overlap only, and none of the four repeats the reasoning shape at the conservative threshold, so no Echo panel is asserted and the slot stays silent under the blueprint's explicit permission for silence.
